query:
SELECT id, name, email, phone, "beltRank", "membershipStatus", status, "createdAt", "organizationId"
FROM students
WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%odunela%' OR LOWER(name) LIKE '%seorefunmi%'
ORDER BY "createdAt" ASC;
